title: God Loves A Broken Heart! (MUST WATCH!) ᴴᴰ
paragraphs: in order to get God's attention you better learn how to open your mouth one of the dilemmas or the troubles we face in society today and even in church today is that we want to pray to God conservatively but sometimes there are certain moments in your life where you can't be cute with your prayers there are times where you can't be polished or elegant with your prayers my dear brothers and sisters there are times in life where you just have to

open your mouth and just cry out to God and believe me if it becomes painful enough if the drama begins to take its toll on you if the situation starts to get bad enough you will cry out there won't be any need for anyone else to talk you into prayer no need for someone else to persuade you to pray no need to be convinced to pray and I have learned that when it gets bad enough when that barrier is too great

for you when the waters become troubled you will cry out to the Lord you will open your mouth to God ask the disciples when they were on the Sea of Galilee and a storm started Rachel asked Daniel in the lion's den asked Paul and Silas what they did when they were in prison and change ass blind bartimaeus what he did to get that healing he cried out and you need to learn how to cry out to God to Jesus I need

you Father I need a helping hand and so many of us look to all kinds of things for help first before we go to Jesus we look to help from all kinds of people first we go to science first instead of the creator of all things we go to doctors first instead of the ultimate physician who was Jesus Christ we go to counselors and therapists first when all wisdom belongs to God but me and can't help you people can't help you

no other worldly gods can help you need to cry out to Jesus you need to look to Jesus don't be the type of Christian who wants Jesus just so they won't go to hell they'll say Jesus but not accept him as master and ruler of your heart don't say Jesus but refuse to yield to his will some of us haven't fully gotten to the place where Jesus is really first in our lives some of us really let our emotions call the

shots so what is it that's holding you back from truly living for God what's that private seeing who's that person what's that addiction or bad habit what's that situation you ding too complicated I just want you to know that when you feel like you're the outcast when you are rejected when you're on the fringes of society or the outskirts of the city when like the lepers you have a sickness that no human can heal you better learn how to open your

mouth and cry out to God you know one of the things I love about the Lord is that he loves to go to the places where he can find those who have been rejected those who've been heard and abandoned he loves to go to places that nobody puts hi on the map in fact he's a God who makes it his business to go and find himself in situations where are those who have been forgotten denied shunned away and pushed to the

side and have you ever noticed that we all have a tendency to attract people who are in the same boat as us people with the same kind of drama you're facing the same kind of problems you're going through in your life and I wonder how many people are listening right now who because of whatever drama they face in their lives don't feel connected they don't feel plugged in and find themselves standing afar off people who are smiling on the outside but

crying on the inside people who are going to church but aren't really plugged in and you may be one of those people today you may have found yourself emotionally forward you may be there feeling rejected and afar off but I have news for you today God loves to connect with the people who others consider to be outcasts fix your eyes on him the king of kings and the Lord of lords your cry should only be to him he's the one that

can transform your life and it doesn't matter where you are or what you situated in if you cry out to God in the midst of your dilemma he will bring deliverance if you cry out to God right in the middle of your situation he will bring freedom don't be the type of Christian who just wants Jesus to save them from a problem and after that he becomes secondary we let our anger call for shots we our bodies control us we let

our friends in high places call for shots but we need to get to a place where the Word of God calls the shots for our lives we need to be crying out to God we need to be crying out for his hand to touch our lives we need to be crying out for his love grace and tender mercy and the thing about mercy is you need to thank God for mercy the Bible says the steadfast love of the Lord never ceases

his mercies never come to an end they are new every morning meaning that these aren't recycled mercies these are brand new mercies every day some of us think that God needs to do something spectacular for you to praise Him but just the fact that he allowed me to wake up this morning with life running through my veins that's mercy he's a God who will see you no matter where you are we must recognize him as master how many people are missing

out on the goodness of God because they refused to give him total control over their lives what's that addiction that you've hidden away and left the door locked and closed what's that issue that you think you can never get victory over what is that thing in your life that you haven't opened the door to and allow the Lord Jesus to come in and be in charge of mercy is God giving you the grace the forgiveness the second third fourth fifth chance

that you don't deserve whether you know it or not mercy is what's keeping you breathing right now mercy woke you up this morning whether you know it or not God's mercy was with you while you were driving on the highway all of the accidents with everything that could have happened but mercy was with you in the form protection whether you know it or not it was mercy that kept you from having a nervous breakdown it kept you from losing your mind

it was the mercy of God he's a good God who gives us what we don't deserve I don't deserve eternal life but he offers it to me I don't deserve unconditional love but he offers it to me I don't deserve his amazing grace but he gives it to me but like the woman with the issue of blood when you have an issue that no human resolve when you're in a situation when nobody can help you I want you to know that

if you cry unto God he will hear you he will see you he loves those who feel unloved he wants those who feel lonely and rejected if you cry out to him he will see you it doesn't matter how much drama you have in your life he will see you I don't care how habitual your habits are I don't care how addictive they are if you cry out to God he will answer you regardless of what statistics say regardless of what

your diagnosis may be regardless of opinions cry out to God and He will see you I thank God that he is a God who can see you even in the darkness of the mess you try and hide from everybody else he's a God who will see you even when you're in the worst state of your life God's mercy is bigger than any mistake you ever made that's why the Bible tells us to draw near with confidence to the throne of grace

that we may receive mercy and find grace to help in time of need don't lose yourself in guilt or feelings of being ashamed cry out to God cry out to the Lord he said it in his word call unto me and I will show you great and mighty things he is faithful and loving to hear you and ask for you you
